not_found.reason: The bank income statement has no cost-of-revenue or cost-of-sales line. Interest expense is already netted inside 'Total net revenue', and the noninterest expense lines are operating expenses.

No line qualifies as a separate cost of delivering revenue. Interest expense is already deducted to arrive at net revenue, so taking it again would double-count it. Compensation, occupancy, technology, professional services, marketing and other expense are general operating costs.

The statement has no 'Operating income' or 'Income (loss) from operations' line. 'Income before income tax expense' is pre-tax income, not operating income, and the value is not derived by arithmetic.
The cash-flow statement section in the input has no tables or rows, so no capital expenditures line is available.
